/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2017_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts'] if isinstance(data,dict) else data
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'net income|net loss|income \\(loss\\)|net earnings', txt, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt[:300].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
